author: DailyMail
title: Michael Owen's son James reveals heartbreak over abandoning football dream due to rare blindness condition
text:
In the upcoming Prime Video series 'Meet The Owens', Michael Owen's son James opens up about the devastating impact of Stargardt disease, a rare eye condition that left him clinically blind. Forced to abandon his dreams of becoming a footballer, James shares the emotional toll of the diagnosis and his plans for the future within the family business.
Michael Owen's son James reveals the devastating impact of his rare eye condition Stargardt disease, which left him clinically blind and forced him to abandon his dreams of becoming a footballer.
In the upcoming Prime Video series 'Meet The Owens', both James and his father Michael discuss the emotional fallout from the diagnosis and the guilt Michael felt for passing on the genetic condition. Despite the hardships, James maintains a positive outlook and is considering joining the family business at Manor House Stables
